images.image_prompt:
Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5, mobile-thumbnail-readable. A dominant protagonist, an attractive adult Korean Shorthair orange-and-white cheese-tabby cat with a natural, balanced, sturdy build; bright warm cheese-orange short fur with realistic darker orange tabby stripes; large natural upright ears; a broad clean white blaze running from the forehead down between the eyes toward the pink nose; clean white fur around the mouth and muzzle, on the chin, continuing naturally down the entire neck, chest and belly; all four paws and lower feet covered in clean white fur like four neat white boots, with the white fur rising naturally from the toes and clearly visible whenever the paws are shown; a distinctive small congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around parts of the mouth area, naturally integrated into the otherwise white muzzle, explicitly a permanent fur pattern and never food, dirt or staining; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense realistic fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. World: Roman arena spectacle, location: miniature coastal town square. Event: Giant telescope activation, the mystical sorcerer protector with cloak and glowing power accents performs one decisive action, hugging a giant prop, the wind-whipped blank rescue banner beside a colossal telescope opening a geometric star aperture. The expression is astonished silent gasp; the gesture is hugging a giant prop. Twist: the rescue target is inside the reflection, visibly seen as a tiny trapped figure in the telescope's physically explained mirror boundary. Visual hook: portal behind the hero. Outcome: the stolen artifact chooses the hero, wrapping the cat in warm gold light after the reflection opens. Role: mystical sorcerer protector with cloak and glowing power accents, bright, clearly separated suit colors, no exact emblem. Strong arena silhouette, miniature scale, portal, prop, face, and gesture; safe transparent support and compositing, correct paws and reflections. No cartoon, illustration, 3D render, plastic fur, malformed anatomy, duplicate cats, duplicate limbs, human features, logos, text, watermark, UI, captions, famous artwork, franchise design, actor likeness, readable title.
Required assigned visual details: no official logo, no exact emblem, no exact costume copy.
